apparatus.note: The original 1901 marginal apparatus records: “Most of the ancient authorities read babes.”

The 1901 printing has faint- at a physical line break followed by hearted; this does not establish underlying lexical hyphenation. Primary USX retains faint-hearted; USFM uses fainthearted. No forced correction.

scope_note: Selected major original 1901 marginal notes, supplemented by all original scanned printed apparatus and byte-preserved original digital USX notes; not a modern textual-critical reconstruction.
